title: Quantum Protein Folding: NISQ Feasibility Proof
hardware_target: IBM Eagle (127q, 300 CNOT limit) / IBM Heron (133q, 500 CNOT limit)

nisq_feasibility.strategy: Active space (8-10q) + Z2 tapering (-2q) + parity reduction (-2q)

key_claim: Fragment-based ADAPT-VQE achieves chemical accuracy on ALL peptide backbone fragments and aromatic side chains within IBM Eagle/Heron NISQ constraints, and correctly predicts alpha-helical fold for Gly5-Ala5 via many-body expansion with 35x signal-to-noise over thermal energy at 300K.
